description: Agent Observability: submit the list of an agent’s action types, each with the tools it uses and whether its runs are traced and logged; the tools the agent reaches, each with whether calls go through the traced path and the other ways the agent reaches it (a direct API key, a shell, a browser session); and either recent runs with whether a trace and log records were kept for each, or which runs keep traces and logs (all runs, a sample with its share, failures only, successes only, on request or none). The signed report lists each action, tool and run selection with its coverage, and names the blind spots: action types with no trace, tools reachable outside the traced path, and records kept for some runs but not others; then actions traced and not logged, tools an action uses that the list leaves out and reachable tools no action names, with the fix for each. Whether a gateway sits in front of every paid or external call is wever_gateway-coverage-check, which tools are exposed to an agent at all is wever_tool-exposure-check and whether one run’s trace reconstructs is wever_observability-trace-check. Verdict blind_spots, coverage_gaps, coverage_unverified or fully_covered. POST /api/observability-coverage-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-observability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-observability/.
